critical_code_review_comments: server.py _verify_reset_code: when (tok['attempts'] >= MAX_RESET_CODE_ATTEMPTS) the token is marked used, which is correct, but the 'left' math on wrong attempt (`left = MAX_RESET_CODE_ATTEMPTS - tok['attempts'] - 1`) uses the stale attempts value from BEFORE the $inc. Current semantics: 1st wrong -> '3 deneme hakkınız kaldı' (because attempts was 0 before inc, left=5-0-1=4... actually 5-0-1=4). Expectation per spec text would be 'you have 4 left' after 1st fail — matches. On 5th attempt (attempts=4 pre-inc), left=5-4-1=0 -> message switches to 'Lütfen yeni kod isteyin.'; the token becomes attempts=5 and the NEXT call hits the MAX_RESET_CODE_ATTEMPTS branch and invalidates. Behaviour is correct but off-by-one logic deserves a comment in code.

server.py seed/startup logic (fringe): if an admin manually renames Özkan via /api/admin/users to a different email, a future seed_admin reload could re-insert the original row — recommend keying seed on user_key / id rather than email so hot restarts never overwrite admin's chosen address.

SifremiUnuttum.jsx: on resend (forgot-resend-btn) the component calls sendCode() which resets 'info' only via setStep success path. If backend returns 429 'Kod az önce gönderildi', the stale 'info' remains visible along with the new error; both messages shown simultaneously is slightly confusing. Minor UX.
UserManagement.jsx admin edit form has no inline 'confirm password' field. Admin changing a user's password sees no masking confirmation — minor usability.

ChangePassword.jsx on success stores the new token via localStorage.setItem('ks_token', data.token) directly, bypassing the AuthContext setter. Works today because axios interceptor reads from localStorage, but AuthContext.user/token state in memory is NOT updated — any component reading `user` from context still has the old token value in auth header set by context. Low impact (next refresh fixes it) but inconsistent.
